applied.problem: "Both rules start from the radius" and the bold "πd ... both from the radius" are not true as worded: C = πd starts from the diameter, as screen 2 itself works it (π × 10). Also "a wire 2 mm across" must be solid and round for π × 1² to give its cross-section.

It describes things the screens do not draw: screen 4 has no grid of 1 cm squares (only the square on the radius is split into 1 cm squares), and screen 1 lays the diameter under the track three times and a bit, not beside it.
